settings.guideHtml:
Overview
  • Start page with search, favorites, to-do, notes, weather, news.
  • All local: data stays in your browser (localStorage).
Shortcuts
  • Ctrl/Cmd+K: open command palette
  • 1-9: open first 9 favorites (when not typing)
  • / : focus search (also via palette)
  • Enter in search: start search
  • ESC: close modals
  • Palette: quick actions for widgets, theme, background, data, favorites
  • Palette: key C switches card style, "Reset header colors" resets search & clock
Search & Autocomplete
  • Bangs: !g !ddg !bing !yt !wiki !maps !sx
  • Custom shortcuts: JSON in settings; {q} as placeholder
  • Autocomplete: bangs, shortcuts, recent searches, wordlist (global + preset)
  • Tab accepts suggestion, Enter starts search
Tiles
  • Drag & drop to sort, click to open
  • + Tile: add a new favorite
  • Reset: restore default favorites
Widgets & Layout
  • Visibility per widget
  • Card style is global (glass, solid, transparent, soft minimal)
  • Custom colors for clock/search; reset restores style defaults
  • Widget colors & "Tint widgets" set the accent per card
Background
  • Presets, uploads, collections, rotation (time/theme/interval)
  • Accent color is extracted from the active background
Data
  • Export/Import as JSON
  • Load data presets (assets/presets/*.json in the repo)
Startpage Agent
  • Integrated AI chat with local Ollama (host/model in settings).
  • Supports streaming responses, stop (button/ESC), persistent history, and Markdown.
  • Agentic tools can read/change widgets and settings (depending on confirm mode).

ollamaGuide.title: Ollama setup for Startpage Agent
ollamaGuide.intro: Startpage Agent runs locally through Ollama on your machine. Install Ollama, start the local service, pull a model, and make sure Startpage can reach {host}.
ollamaGuide.jumpNote: This guide stays available in Settings > Guide, even if the AI tab is hidden.
ollamaGuide.downloadHint: Download the installer from the official Ollama website.
ollamaGuide.modelHint: You can install other Ollama models as well, but ministral-3:8b is the recommended default for this Startpage setup.

actions.copyError: Could not copy the command to the clipboard.

check.idle: Use "Check setup" to test the configured Ollama host.
check.unavailable: No response from {host}. Check whether Ollama is running and whether port 11434 is reachable.

osNotes.linux: If you use a distro package manager, keep the official Ollama docs nearby because package versions may lag behind.
osNotes.macos: Homebrew is useful on developer machines; the direct download is usually simpler for first-time setup.
osNotes.windows: On managed Windows systems, the installer or the first Ollama launch may trigger Windows Defender or firewall prompts.

ollamaGuide.originsIntro: Ollama allows localhost-style origins by default. If your Startpage runs from another origin, you must explicitly allow it with OLLAMA_ORIGINS and, for remote access, usually bind OLLAMA_HOST to 0.0.0.0:11434.
ollamaGuide.originsIntroLocal: Your current Startpage origin is {origin}. Localhost-style origins are usually allowed by Ollama already, so OLLAMA_ORIGINS is often not needed during local development.
ollamaGuide.originLinux: If your Startpage runs from {pageUrl}, add the origin {origin} to OLLAMA_ORIGINS.
ollamaGuide.originMacos: If your Startpage runs from {pageUrl}, add the origin {origin} to OLLAMA_ORIGINS.
ollamaGuide.originWindows: If your Startpage runs from {pageUrl}, add the origin {origin} to OLLAMA_ORIGINS.
ollamaGuide.originLinuxLocal: Your current Startpage runs from {pageUrl}. If you later deploy it under another domain, replace OLLAMA_ORIGINS with that deployed origin.
ollamaGuide.originMacosLocal: Your current Startpage runs from {pageUrl}. If you later deploy it under another domain, replace OLLAMA_ORIGINS with that deployed origin.
ollamaGuide.originWindowsLocal: Your current Startpage runs from {pageUrl}. If you later deploy it under another domain, replace OLLAMA_ORIGINS with that deployed origin.
ollamaGuide.linuxServiceHint: If Ollama runs as a systemd service, create an override instead of editing the main unit file directly.
ollamaGuide.windowsEnvHint: Open Windows environment variables, create user variables named OLLAMA_HOST and OLLAMA_ORIGINS, then restart the Ollama app.
ollamaGuide.restartMacos: Restart the Ollama app after changing launchctl environment variables.
ollamaGuide.restartWindows: Quit and restart the Ollama app after saving the environment variables.
ollamaGuide.networkLinux: If Startpage runs in another browser profile, VM, or container, make sure {host} is reachable and the local firewall allows port 11434.
ollamaGuide.networkMacos: If the browser cannot reach {host}, check macOS firewall prompts and allow local incoming connections for Ollama.
ollamaGuide.networkWindows: If Startpage cannot reach {host}, allow Ollama through Windows Defender Firewall and keep port 11434 available locally.
